entries: Could we move the project meeting to Thursday? I need another day to finish the cost estimate.
We look forward to reviewing your estimate. I will update the invitation and reserve a room for ten people.
My flight lands at six in the evening. Is there a shuttle from the airport to the hotel?
Yes, our shuttle leaves every thirty minutes. Please meet the driver outside Terminal Two.
The order was dispatched yesterday, but the tracking page still shows no update. Could you check its status?
The carrier collected it this morning. The tracking information should appear tonight, and delivery is expected on Friday.
Thank you for applying for the analyst position. Could you attend an interview next Tuesday at ten?
Yes, that time is convenient. Should I bring copies of my résumé and references?
The copier keeps stopping after a few pages. We have already replaced the paper and checked for a jam.
I will inspect it this afternoon. Please use the printer on the second floor until the repair is complete.
We received your invoice, but the purchase order number is missing. Could you send a corrected copy?
Certainly. I will add the number and send the revised invoice today. Payment is due within thirty days.
Could you confirm whether the replacement parts will arrive by Thursday? Our maintenance team needs them for the weekend inspection.
The parts are ready to ship today. I will send the tracking number this afternoon and let you know immediately if the delivery date changes.
Before you begin, please collect your identification badge from reception. The orientation session starts at ten in the training room.
Thank you. Should I bring my laptop, or will the company provide one for the session?
A laptop will be provided. You only need the welcome email, which contains your temporary login details.
